jobs.detail: PRONE ALTERNATING HIP EXTENSION, THREE phases in THREE equal side-by-side panels. Elevated rear-side three-quarter view makes BOTH legs separate/visible, head IMAGE LEFT feet IMAGE RIGHT. Lie FACE DOWN on floor, FOREHEAD on folded hands, neutral neck gaze to floor, chest/abdomen/pelvis supported, no looking up. Both legs STRAIGHT, toes pointing down. LEFT panel both straight legs rest on floor. MIDDLE panel lift only RIGHT straight leg modestly10-15degrees from HIP, RIGHT knee stays straight, LEFT leg stays floor. RIGHT panel lower right leg back floor and lift only LEFT straight leg10-15degrees, left knee straight. Same model, limb identities, camera and leg lengths, not rolling torso or pelvis; pelvis/hip bones stay pressed down, no lumbar arch. Glutes only: very faint SOFT DIFFUSE RED color teaching tint on fully opaque BLACK rear shorts fabric over buttock regions, never glute muscle boundaries/fibers, never bare buttocks or skin/cutaway at crotch. All other anatomy grayscale. Shorts loosely wrap hips, seat, crotch and both thighs from ALL directions with seams/closed hems, shirt BLACK. Hands/head/both shoes fully within EACH spacious panel.

jobs.detail: LYING HIP FLEXOR / QUADRICEPS STRETCH, ONE STATIC HOLD, ONE person ONLY. SIDE three-quarter view shows pelvis at FOOT END EDGE of a stable padded flat BENCH, complete bench legs/base visible. Supine on bench with HEAD, shoulders, back and pelvis FULLY supported. Head IMAGE LEFT, bench foot-end IMAGE RIGHT, pelvis near end. Hold LEFT knee toward chest with BOTH hands clasped behind LEFT thigh (not kneecap), LEFT hip/knee flexed, left foot relaxed above bench. RIGHT nonheld leg hangs DOWN BEYOND bench foot-end at IMAGE RIGHT: right thigh descends modestly from hip, right knee naturally bent about90degrees, right foot hangs free above floor, no toe/heel contact with floor or bench. Lower back gently flat against pad, pelvis neutral not hyperextended, no bridging. Clear continuous anatomy both legs no missing limbs, right thigh passes OVER foot-end edge without blockage. Primary RIGHT QUADRICEPS only a soft BLURRED RED tint printed on intact BLACK front-thigh shorts on hanging leg; no red held thigh/glutes/abdomen, no visible fiber divisions in garment.
